fusions.name: Fouled Fan
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of reeking arrows ahead of you, dealing 9 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Barb
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. It ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Not Twice
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, attackers take back 50% of the damage they deal to you, with a 30% chance to be confused for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Keeps Them Off
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises 10% against enemies suffering an affliction.
